title: Addition Volume Discount on Microsoft 365 Partial-Cycle Charges
content:
Larger Microsoft 365 Cloud Subscriptions (CSP) seat additions take an addition volume discount on the partial-cycle charge. The discount is a percentage of the prorated amount, which is the amount for the days charged on the licenses added. It is taken off that prorated amount and does not reduce the provisioning fee.

| Licenses added by the seat addition | Discount taken off the prorated amount |
|---|---|
| 10 or more | 5 percent |
| 3 to 9 | 2 percent |
| 1 or 2 | none |

**Edges of the bands.** 2 licenses take no discount, and 3 take 2 percent. 9 licenses take 2 percent, and 10 take 5 percent.

**Which licenses count.** The count is the quantity of the one seat addition being charged. Earlier seat additions on the subscription are not added in.

## Hypothetical illustration

A seat addition of 12 licenses has a prorated amount of 800.00 USD. 5 percent of 800.00 is 40.00, which is taken off. With 6 licenses and a prorated amount of 400.00, the discount is 2 percent of 400.00, which is 8.00.
